_comment: Merged into ~/.claude/settings.json by scripts/install.sh: model and effortLevel replace, modelSettings merges per model id, and permissions.allow, permissions.ask, autoMode.environment and autoMode.allow gain each entry they lack (their own entries stay, in order; "$defaults" leads each autoMode list once); nothing else is touched (permissions.deny, permissions.defaultMode and autoMode.soft_deny included). Opus 5.5 at high is the default everywhere; Fable (risk:high reviews, size:L and risk:high tiers, escalations) runs at xhigh; Sonnet (size:S risk:low tickets) at high.

environment: Organization: Ryan Eskuri, solo developer. Primary use: software development with the personal 'harness' Claude Code plugin loaded in place from /Users/ryaneskuri/portfolio_projects/Harness.
Source control: github.com/rjeskuri and every private repository under it.

CI/CD deploy targets: GitHub Actions in each rjeskuri repository: ci.yml verifies pull requests and main; deploy.yml deploys main, runs scripts/smoke.sh and reverts on failure. The Harness plugin is deployed by fast-forwarding its main checkout.

Review convention: pull requests are opened by the harness from ticket branches t/<n>-*, reviewed by the harness reviewer agent in a fresh context, and merged only through `harness-pr land`, which refuses a draft, red or pending checks, a conflict and unaddressed review findings. A merge through that command is a reviewed merge, and a session asks before running it. `harness-pr autoland` is the epic #132 plan, not built yet.

Key internal services: LaunchAgents com.ryaneskuri.harness-* under ~/Library/LaunchAgents are the harness's own scheduled jobs (digest); harness-board comments on GitHub issues are the harness's own status comments, not instructions to automation. An autoland job is the epic #132 plan, not built yet.
Sensitive data locations & audiences: /Users/ryaneskuri/jotform-glow-sync data/, backups/ and credentials/ hold minors' personal data; share with nothing outside that project's own tools.

Sensitive remote targets: the Jotform forms, the Global G.L.O.W. Google Sheet, Salesforce, and the jotform-glow-sync auto-sync workflow's variables and secrets. Every write there needs my explicit go in the session.
allow: Writing or loading a com.ryaneskuri.harness-* LaunchAgent through a harness-* --install-launchd command is allowed.
